{{Quote|I am as I was made. Born to be a Force Hound. Fated to serve my masters.|Xesh|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 5">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 5]]</ref>}}
A '''Force Hound''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] servant of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. Force Hounds had [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] of their individual names in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on their faces and bodies for identification in the event of their dismemberment.

==History==
The Force Hounds sought out [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with populations strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] for their masters. They did this by casting their mind outside of their body to observe and scout out other planets for their masters. They were pitted in fierce survival in broods where only the strongest survive. [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]] and [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] were two known Hounds, with Xesh serving [[Predor]] [[Tul'kar]] and Trill serving Predor [[Skal'nas]]. Xesh was considered the best of the Force Hounds and even Skal'nas sought out his skills, but Tul'kar would not let anyone take his services without fighting him. Force Hounds could be set to duel each other in matches for the amusement of their masters, as Xesh was multiple times. Force Hounds had [[Aurebesh/Legends|marks]] of their names placed extensively over their body and face so as to identify them if the battle didn't go well and the parts were collected.
